data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Alexandros', meaning 'defender of the people'. A popular name in the Greek and Roman world, it was borne by several saints and early Christian martyrs. The name Alick carries the meaning “Ruler of the people” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alick usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the people and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alick total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
